name: Greek Lemon Chicken with Roasted Potatoes

components.name: Greek Lemon Chicken

ingredients.name: Raw bone-in chicken thighs and drumsticks

steps: Mix yogurt, lemon, oil, vinegar, oregano, garlic, salt and pepper; coat chicken and refrigerate at least three hours, preferably overnight.
Arrange marinated chicken on a separate tray to avoid raw poultry juices contaminating potatoes after cooking.
Roast the chicken until the skin browns and the centre reaches 74 C, typically 45-60 minutes for bone-in portions; turn the potatoes halfway through their 40-50 minute roasting time.
Rest chicken 5-10 minutes. Divide edible meat and potato wedges equally into five portions. Keep additional lemon for serving if desired.

components.name: Roasted Potato Wedges

ingredients.name: Raw waxy potatoes cut into wedges

steps: Heat oven to 200 C. Toss raw wedges with their olive oil, lemon, oregano, garlic powder and salt; spread over a large tray.
